desc: Prove the exact pairwise conflict characterization, including proper crossings, shared endpoints, containment, identical intervals, and opposite travel directions.
Derive an efficient sweep/data-structure algorithm for the maximum prior conflicting index of each person.
Reduce each query to a range maximum test over prior-conflict values and prove correctness.
Implement the complete Python solution with fast I/O and verify it against both samples and edge cases.
Establish total time and memory complexity within the given constraints.
